branches.title: Geometric solver vs standard-equation side-by-side pipeline
branches.intent: Build an auditable Python-capable comparison harness for matched SAT/H(s)H geometric-solver and standard/reference-equation cases without hiding target leakage, fit freedom, units, transformations, or representation assumptions.
exposure_constraints: Do not treat numerical agreement as derivation or validation
dependencies: Recover or preserve candidate status of the exact Hagalaz operator
Use one declared shared material/director gauge before comparing translation residuals
Inject cross-solver disturbances at the shared primitive 4D data level before deriving either representation
Identify a Hagalaz geometric-admissibility observable homologous to the Three-Spheres carrier constraint, or explicitly classify the benchmark as complementary-channel only
branches.last_material_state: ACTIVE-EDGE CORRECTION: Meridian Run 080 (commit 169af392289b2b0cc31611be1247c63380399189) audited the proposed cross-solver perturbation and found that Run 077's derived-edge corruption cannot be reused as a fair Hagalaz ↔ Three-Spheres benchmark. A cross-solver disturbance must enter the shared primitive absolute 4D center/director dataset first, after which both Hagalaz and Three-Spheres representations are regenerated. Run 080 also exposed a typing distinction: the current Hagalaz loop residual tests representation consistency, whereas the recovered Three-Spheres closure/gate machinery tests geometric admissibility. Equal response is not expected unless a genuinely homologous Hagalaz geometric-admissibility channel is identified. Runs 078 and 079 remain controlling for shared translation gauge and carrier-before-readout typing. Exact Hagalaz source remains unrecovered and candidate status is unchanged.
branches.next_cursor: Before generating numerical response curves, identify or construct the narrowest candidate Hagalaz geometric-admissibility observable consuming the same primitive 4D sphere/frame data as the Three-Spheres carrier constraint. If none exists in recovered non-quarantined material, explicitly classify the comparison as complementary-channel only. Then perturb one primitive center/director state upstream of both representations, regenerate both sides, and report typed response channels separately; do not collapse them into one scalar or claim residual equivalence without a homologous observable.
branches.exit_criterion: One paired case runs through both sides from a shared manifest with reproducible metadata and an auditable comparison report.
